GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.5 (5 Feb 47) LS-R
(SCAPIN - 1507)
APO 500
5 February 1947
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Apprehension of Suspected War Criminal.
Memorandum to the Imperial Japanese Government dated 29 May 46, file AG 000.5 (29 May 46) LS-R, (SCAPIN 988), wherein the Imperial Japanese Government was directed to deliver one NAGAO, Yoshihei, Major, to the Commanding General, EIGHTH Army at Sugamo Prison (Tokyo Detention Camp), at the earliest possible date, is amended to delete said NAGAO's name for the reason that he is no longer required. This name appears as the fifth name on Page No. 3 of the above-mentioned Memorandum.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
